description: REQ-A3 (behavioral-spec.md:35-36) specifies StandardOutPath/StandardErrorPath as '$HOME/.openclaw/logs/<slot>-proactive.{out,err}'. The parent architecture spec §3 (line 117-118) uses literal '/Users/operator/.openclaw/logs/<SLOT>-proactive.out|err'. launchd plists do NOT expand $HOME — plutil/launchd treat the string verbatim and the job will silently fail to open its stdout/stderr file, falling back to /dev/null. The spec must say the rendered plist contains the EXPANDED absolute path (e.g. '/Users/<user>/.openclaw/logs/...'), not the literal token '$HOME'. Otherwise REQ-A3 is unimplementable as written and contradicts the parent template.

evidence.snippet: THE PLIST SHALL set StandardOutPath and StandardErrorPath to $HOME/.openclaw/logs/<slot>-proactive.{out,err}
